selection_rule: Highest c_npmi among models that assign a topic to at least 80 percent of the 5,292 comments. Somali-trained encoders are in that pool and are selected when their coherence is higher. Manual labels were not a training target.
language_limitation: The cited model is NMF on bag-of-words counts after the project function-word list was removed. AfriBERTa and AfroXLMR were in the comparison and had lower c_npmi, so they were not selected. Coherence does not confirm a public-policy theme. A Somali-trained encoder in the comparison is not evidence that the cited model understands Somali.
